mapper.select:
select distinct B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, B.FINPROD_ABBR text, A.FINPROD_ID object from SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID
and ( B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or B.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') )

select T.ENTRUST_ID id, T.ENTRUST_ID text from ETR_ENTRUST T
and A.APPLY_TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')

select distinct A.APPLY_TRADE_ID id, A.APPLY_TRADE_ID text from SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL A INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS B ON A.SEQ_ID = B.SEQ_NO
1=1 AND (B.MATCH_STATUS IN (#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_01},#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_02}) OR B.MATCH_STATUS IS NULL)
and A.APPLY_TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')

select distinct A.SEC_ACCT_ID id, B.SEC_ACCT_NAME text from SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL A INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON A.SEC_ACCT_ID = B.SEC_ACCT_ID
and ( SEC_ACCT_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or SEC_ACCT_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') )

select distinct A.SEQ_ID id, A.SEQ_ID text from SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL A INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS B ON A.SEQ_ID = B.SEQ_NO
1=1 AND (B.MATCH_STATUS IN (#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_01},#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_02}) OR B.MATCH_STATUS IS NULL)
and APPLY_TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')

SELECT distinct s1.APPLY_TRADE_ID applyTradeId, s1.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, s2.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, s5.MATCH_CLASS matchType, s1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, s1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, s1.TRADE_PLAT tradePlat, NVL(S6.MARCH_QTY_EN,0) shareAmt, NVL(S6.MARCH_AMT_EN,0) tradeAmt, s1.UNIT_FPRICE unitFprice FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL s1 LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH s5 ON s1.SEQ_ID = s5.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO s2 ON s2.SEC_ACCT_ID=s1.SEC_ACCT_ID INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS s4 ON s4.SEQ_NO=s1.SEQ_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SEQ_NO, NVL(SUM(MARCH_QTY),0) MARCH_QTY_EN, NVL(SUM(MARCH_AMT),0) MARCH_AMT_EN FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH GROUP BY SEQ_NO ) S6 ON S6.SEQ_NO = S1.SEQ_ID WHERE s1.SEQ_ID=#{seqNo}

SELECT s1.ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID entrustId, e1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, p1.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, s3.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, CASE WHEN s3.SEC_TYPE=#{SEC_TYPE_09} THEN NULL ELSE f1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END finprodMarketId, CASE WHEN s3.SEC_TYPE=#{SEC_TYPE_09} THEN NULL ELSE f1.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, e1.PS ps, e1.PRICE price, NVL(S4.MARCH_QTY,0) entrustNum, NVL(S4.MARCH_AMT,0) entrustAmt, e1.ENTRUST_DATE entrustDate FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH s1 INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS s2 ON s2.SEQ_NO=s1.SEQ_NO AND s2.MATCH_STATUS IN (#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_1},#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_2}) INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL s3 ON s3.SEQ_ID=s1.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST e1 ON e1.ENTRUST_ID=s1.ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON f1.FINPROD_ID=s3.FINPROD_ID LEFT join PTL_PORTFOLIO p1 on p1.PORTFOLIO_ID=e1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SEQ_NO, ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID, NVL(SUM(MARCH_QTY_EN),0) MARCH_QTY, NVL(SUM(MARCH_AMT_EN),0) MARCH_AMT FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_MATCH GROUP BY SEQ_NO,ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID ) S4 ON S4.SEQ_NO = S1.SEQ_NO AND S4.ENTRUNST_TRADE_ID = E1.ENTRUST_ID WHERE s1.seq_no=#{seqNo}
